pages.text: Radiation spreads from its source in straight lines and weakens with distance. Each block in its way takes some off: an ordinary wall very little, water a little more, a block of lead nearly all of it.$(br2)A Geiger counter clicks when it reaches you, and a dose shows as the Radiation effect.
pages.title: How it travels

pages.text: A $(item)Radiation Shielding Panel$() stops all radiation passing through it. Wall a reactor or a store room with panels and nothing reaches the other side.$(br2)Panels side by side join into one riveted wall.
The $(item)Radiation Shielding Window$() is a thick lead-framed pane. It lets a tenth of the radiation through and all of the light. Windows side by side join into one sheet of glass.
The $(item)Radiation Shielding Door$() blocks nearly all radiation while it is shut and almost none while it is open. Open it by hand or with redstone, and keep it shut.
All three are as hard as iron.
